airspace.zh: 坦尚尼亞國家公園管理局（TANAPA）自2014年11月6日起，禁止在國家公園空域使用各種大小的無人機進行拍照、攝影等用途，吉力馬札羅國家公園也適用；在坦尚尼亞操作無人機另須符合民航局（TCAA）規定。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Since 6 November 2014 Tanzania National Parks (TANAPA) has barred drones of all sizes from national park airspace for photography, filming and other purposes, Kilimanjaro National Park included; drone use in Tanzania must also meet Tanzania Civil Aviation Authority rules. Check the current rules before any real flight.

summit.note: Summit on the rim of Kibo (03°04′33″S 37°21′12″E)

saddle.note: Plateau between Kibo and Mawenzi; approximate

farms.en: Chagga farmland on the lower slopes

marangu.note: Park gate on the south-east; approximate

moshi.note: Town at the foot of the mountain; approximate

tagline.zh-Hant: 1848年的雪山報告、1889年首登，到1973年的國家公園
tagline.en: A report of snow in 1848, the first ascent in 1889, a national park in 1973

zh: 查加人世代住在吉力馬札羅山的南坡與東坡。
他們在火山土壤上耕作。
en: The Chagga have long lived on the southern and eastern slopes,
farming the rich volcanic soil.

zh: 1848年，傳教士約翰內斯·雷布曼報告看見這座山。
他是第一個描述這座山的歐洲人。
en: In 1848 the missionary Johannes Rebmann reported seeing the mountain,
the first European to describe it.

zh: 他說赤道附近的山頂上有雪，當時許多人不相信。
南坡的一條冰河，後來以他命名。
en: He reported snow on a summit near the Equator, and many did not believe him.
A glacier on the southern side was later named after him.

zh: 1889年10月6日，漢斯·梅耶與路德維希·普切勒登上頂峰。
這是第一次有紀錄的登頂。
en: On 6 October 1889 Hans Meyer and Ludwig Purtscheller reached the top,
the first recorded ascent.

zh: 當地人約哈尼·勞沃，被認為是梅耶團隊的成員。
來自潘加尼的姆維尼·阿馬尼，負責供應高地營地。
en: Yohani Kinyala Lauwo, a local man, is recognised as a member of Meyer's team,
and Mwini Amani of Pangani kept the high camps supplied.

zh: 1912年，山頂冰的面積約有11.4平方公里。
到2011年，已經不到1平方公里。
en: In 1912 the ice on the summit covered about 11.4 square kilometres.
By 2011 it was under 1 square kilometre.

zh: 將近一百年，冰減少了將近85%。
研究者認為，冰河可能在幾十年內消失。
en: In nearly a century, almost 85 per cent of the ice was lost.
Researchers think the glaciers may vanish within decades.

zh: 國家獨立後，最高點改名為「烏呼魯峰」。
烏呼魯在斯瓦希里語裡，意思是「自由」。
en: After independence the highest point was renamed Uhuru Peak.
Uhuru means freedom in Swahili.

zh: 1973年，吉力馬札羅山被劃為國家公園。
當時只保護了山上的部分森林。
en: In 1973 Kilimanjaro became a national park,
though only small corridors of forest were protected at first.

zh: 2005年，公園邊界重劃，納入更多山地森林。
森林是山下居民的水源。
en: In 2005 the boundary was redrawn to take in more montane forest,
the source of water for the people below.

zh: 1987年，吉力馬札羅國家公園列入世界遺產。
登錄的理由，是它壯麗的自然景觀。
en: In 1987 Kilimanjaro National Park joined the World Heritage List
for its outstanding natural beauty.

zh: 今天，每年約有五萬人來攀登。
平均約七到八成的人能登頂。
en: Today some 50,000 trekkers come each year,
and on average 70 to 80 per cent reach the top.

zh: 從雪山的傳聞、第一次登頂，到國家公園，
吉力馬札羅一直吸引著人們往上走。
en: From rumours of snow to the first ascent and a national park,
Kilimanjaro has always drawn people upward.

tagline.zh-Hant: 查加人的家園菜園、登山口的小鎮，與帶人上山的嚮導和挑夫
tagline.en: Chagga home gardens, the towns at the gates, and the guides and porters

zh: 吉力馬札羅山的南坡，是查加人的家園。
肥沃的火山土壤，讓這裡成為重要的農業區。
en: The southern slopes of Kilimanjaro are the homeland of the Chagga.
Rich volcanic soil makes this an important farming region.

zh: 人們在山坡上種玉米和豆子，經營家園菜園與咖啡園。
山上的森林，把雨水留住，供應農田。
en: People grow maize and beans, and keep home gardens and coffee farms.
The forest above holds the rain that waters them.

zh: 查加人過去分成多個小王國。
這些王國在1963年被廢除。
en: The Chagga were once organised into several small states,
abolished in 1963.

zh: 這一帶出產的咖啡，常以「吉力馬札羅」為名銷往各地。
山的名字，也跟著咖啡走進世界各地的咖啡館。
en: Coffee from these slopes is often sold under the Kilimanjaro name,
carrying the mountain's name into cafés around the world.

zh: 山腳下的莫希，是登山客的出發地。
嚮導、挑夫與裝備，大多在這裡集合。
en: Moshi, at the foot of the mountain, is where climbers set out.
Guides, porters and gear mostly gather here.

zh: 東南邊的馬蘭古登山口，是最早開放的路線之一。
其他路線分別從南面和西面上山。
en: Marangu Gate on the south-east is one of the oldest routes up,
and other routes climb from the south and west.

zh: 登山客穿過雨林，再走進荒原。
嚮導和挑夫，背著帳篷、食物和水，一路同行。
en: Climbers pass through rainforest, then out onto the moorland.
Guides and porters walk with them, carrying tents, food and water.

zh: 高山上的空氣稀薄，登山需要時間適應。
慢慢走，是在這座山上最常聽到的建議。
en: The air is thin up high, and the body needs time to adjust.
"Slowly, slowly" is the advice most often heard on this mountain.

zh: 登頂通常在半夜出發，在日出前後到達。
站在烏呼魯峰上，非洲在腳下展開。
en: Summit attempts usually start at midnight and arrive around sunrise.
From Uhuru Peak, Africa spreads out below.

zh: 1936年，海明威發表短篇小說《吉力馬札羅的雪》。
赤道上的雪山，從此也成了文學裡的意象。
en: In 1936 Ernest Hemingway published his story "The Snows of Kilimanjaro".
The snowy summit on the Equator became an image in literature too.

zh: 山的名字來源，至今仍有爭論。
有人說是「偉大之山」，有人說是「白色的山」。
en: The origin of the mountain's name is still debated:
"mountain of greatness", some say; "white mountain", say others.

zh: 也有人認為，它來自查加語的「無法攀登」。
如今，每年有約五萬人嘗試登上它。
en: Others trace it to a Chagga word for "unclimbable".
Today some 50,000 people a year try to climb it.

zh: 登頂者在山頂拍照留念，
而山下的家園，靠著這座山的水與土地生活。
en: Those who reach the top take their photographs,
while the homes below live on the mountain's water and soil.

zh: 從山腳的農田、登山口的小鎮，到雲上的頂峰，
吉力馬札羅是一座有人住在它身邊的山。
en: From the farms at its foot and the towns at its gates to the summit above the clouds,
Kilimanjaro is a mountain that people live beside.

tagline.zh-Hant: 一座山上的五個世界：雨林、荒原、高山荒漠與赤道冰河
tagline.en: Five worlds on one mountain: rainforest, moorland, alpine desert and equatorial ice

zh: 海拔1,800到2,800公尺，是一圈茂密的山地雨林。
從空中看，像一條深綠色的帶子圍著山。
en: Between 1,800 and 2,800 metres a dense ring of montane rainforest circles the mountain,
a dark green band seen from the air.

zh: 森林接住從印度洋吹來的水氣。
山下的溪流與泉水，大多從這裡開始。
en: The forest catches moisture blowing in from the Indian Ocean.
Most streams and springs below begin here.

zh: 林中有黑白疣猴等靈長類。
研究人員在森林帶裡，區分出好幾種不同的森林類型。
en: Black-and-white colobus and other primates live in the forest,
and researchers distinguish several forest types within the belt.

zh: 森林之上，是寒冷乾燥的荒原。
這裡長著巨型千里光和巨型半邊蓮。
en: Above the forest lies cold, dry moorland,
home to giant groundsels and giant lobelias.

zh: 這些植物長得又高又奇特。
它們適應了白天日曬、夜晚結凍的環境。
en: These plants grow tall and strange,
adapted to sun by day and frost by night.

zh: 四千公尺以上，植物愈來愈稀少。
高山荒漠白天炎熱，夜晚寒冷，雨水很少。
en: Above 4,000 metres plants grow ever more scarce.
The alpine desert is hot by day, freezing by night, and dry.

zh: 馬文濟的岩峰上，只剩地衣與苔蘚。
生命在這裡，退到最低限度。
en: On the crags of Mawenzi only lichens and mosses cling on.
Life here is pared down to the minimum.

zh: 山頂上的富特文格勒冰河，是殘存的赤道冰河之一。
冰的邊緣，是垂直的冰崖。
en: The Furtwängler Glacier on the summit is one of the last equatorial glaciers.
Its edges are vertical ice cliffs.

zh: 南坡的雷布曼冰河，也在逐漸縮小。
從1912年到2011年，山上的冰減少了將近85%。
en: The Rebmann Glacier on the southern side is shrinking too.
Between 1912 and 2011 the mountain lost almost 85 per cent of its ice.

zh: 山下的農田一直延伸到森林邊緣。
1973年設立的公園，只保護了小段森林走廊。
en: Below, farmland reaches right up to the forest edge.
The park of 1973 protected only small forest corridors.

zh: 2005年擴大範圍後，更多山地森林受到保護。
保護森林，就是保護山下的水源。
en: Since the 2005 expansion more montane forest is protected,
and protecting the forest protects the water below.

zh: 從正上方看，基博火山口的冰，只剩零星幾塊。
赤道上的冰，正在一年一年地變少。
en: From straight above, only scattered patches of ice remain on Kibo's crater.
Year by year, the ice on the Equator grows smaller.

zh: 從雨林、荒原、荒漠到冰河，
一座山就是一趟從赤道走到極地的旅程。
en: From rainforest and moorland to desert and ice,
one mountain is a journey from the Equator to the poles.

tagline.zh-Hant: 三座火山錐、從草原到冰河的五個氣候帶
tagline.en: Three volcanic cones, and five climate zones from savanna to ice

zh: 坦尚尼亞的吉力馬札羅山，是非洲最高峰。
最高點烏呼魯峰，海拔5,895公尺。
en: Tanzania's Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.
Its summit, Uhuru Peak, stands 5,895 metres above sea level.

zh: 它是世界上最高的獨立山峰。
山不屬於任何山脈，直接從草原上拔起。
en: It is the highest free-standing mountain in the world,
part of no range, rising straight from the plains.

zh: 吉力馬札羅山由三座火山錐組成。
中間最高的是基博，東邊是馬文濟，西邊是希拉。
en: Kilimanjaro is made of three volcanic cones:
Kibo, the highest, in the middle; Mawenzi to the east; Shira to the west.

zh: 基博火山的火山口寬約2.5公里。
烏呼魯峰，就在火山口的邊緣上。
en: Kibo's caldera is about 2.5 kilometres wide.
Uhuru Peak sits on its rim.

zh: 火山口內還有羅伊施火山口，以及深350公尺的灰坑。
這裡至今仍有冒著氣體的噴氣孔。
en: Inside lie the Reusch Crater and the 350-metre-deep Ash Pit,
where fumaroles still give off gas.

zh: 基博最後一次火山活動，約在十五萬到二十萬年前。
它是一座休眠中的火山。
en: Kibo's last volcanic activity was some 150,000 to 200,000 years ago.
It is a dormant volcano.

zh: 東邊的馬文濟峰，海拔5,149公尺。
它被侵蝕得很厲害，山頂佈滿尖銳的岩峰。
en: To the east, Mawenzi reaches 5,149 metres.
Deeply eroded, it bristles with jagged pinnacles.

zh: 基博與馬文濟之間，是寬約五公里的鞍部高原。
這裡是一片荒涼的高山荒漠。
en: Between Kibo and Mawenzi lies the Saddle, about 5 kilometres wide,
a bleak alpine desert.

zh: 西邊的希拉，是三座火山中最古老的一座。
它的海拔約4,005公尺，頂部是一片高原。
en: To the west, Shira is the oldest of the three cones.
About 4,005 metres high, it is topped by a plateau.

zh: 從山腳到山頂，海拔上升超過五千公尺。
一路經過五個氣候帶。
en: From foot to summit the mountain climbs more than 5,000 metres,
through five climate zones.

zh: 海拔800到1,800公尺是灌木帶，
en: From 800 to 1,800 metres is bushland;
from 1,800 to 2,800, rainforest.

zh: 2,800到4,000公尺是石南與荒原帶。
4,000到5,000公尺，是高山荒漠。
en: From 2,800 to 4,000 metres come heather and moorland,
and from 4,000 to 5,000, alpine desert.

zh: 五千公尺以上，是極地般的山頂帶。
赤道附近的山頂，竟然有冰河。
en: Above 5,000 metres lies an arctic summit zone,
with glaciers near the Equator.

zh: 三座火山、五個氣候帶、赤道上的冰，
吉力馬札羅把一整個大陸的景色，疊在一座山上。
en: Three volcanoes, five climate zones, ice on the Equator:
Kilimanjaro stacks a continent's worth of scenery on one mountain.
